#summary Frozen Bubble for Android Build Instructions.
#labels Phase-Implementation,Featured

= Introduction =

This Wiki entry details how to build Frozen Bubble for Android from the source code.

The project now builds with Android Studio and Gradle.  The full, current instructions are in docs/BUILDING.md in the repository; this page is a short version.

= Details =

  * Install Android Studio.  From its SDK manager, install Android SDK Platform 36, the NDK and CMake (Android Studio offers to install whatever is missing when it syncs).
  * Get the source: `git clone https://github.com/dotelpenguin/frozenbubbleandroid.git`.
  * In Android Studio, choose File → Open and pick the project folder (the one with settings.gradle.kts).
  * Let Gradle sync; the first sync downloads Gradle 9.6 and the Android Gradle Plugin 9.4.
  * Pick a phone or emulator and Run 'app'.

The game needs Android 7.0 (API 24) or later and targets Android 16 (API 36).  The libmodplug music player (C/C++) is built with CMake from app/src/main/cpp, so the NDK is still needed.

= History =

Versions up to 4.4 were built with Eclipse and the ADT bundle, the NDK (ndk-build) and API level 12, from the original Google Code Subversion repository, which no longer exists.
